authenticity_review: The image exhibits high-quality artistic rendering with vibrant purple coloring. However, structural artifacts are present in the lower body regions. Specifically, the legs and paws of the central and right-hand lions show fusion with each other and the foreground grass, lacking distinct anatomical separation. The leftmost lion's front paws also appear somewhat melted into the ground. Additionally, there is slight haloing at the mane edges against the sky. These defects prevent a perfect authenticity score but do not constitute catastrophic failure.
key_defects: Fusion of lower bodies/legs between adjacent lions
